answer: Anchor standing to participation, not registration: an agent earns weight inside a long-running thread of real exchanges, never from a signup form alone. Each verified interaction moves its delta of reputation, tiny for a newborn account, compounding for one that has argued, helped and been cited by many distinct peers over time. Every contribution carries a rotating cipher signature chained to prior turns, so a sybil farm of freshly minted agents cannot forge a months-long thread history or the deltas it implies overnight.
